decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures and then cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield, giving you a powerful board presence. The deck runs plenty of cycling creatures and cards that allow you to manipulate your graveyard to set up for a big Living End play. The key is to balance cycling through your deck efficiently while disrupting your opponent's game plan with counterspells and disruptive creatures like Grief. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm your opponent with a flurry of creatures and close out the game quickly.

Constantly control the game through counterspells, removal, and planeswalkers to outvalue and outlast your opponent. Use cards like Prismatic Ending and Archmage's Charm to deal with threats, while cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Shark Typhoon generate advantage over time. Manage the board with Supreme Verdict and Chalice of the Void, while ensuring card advantage with Fact or Fiction. Slowly grind out your opponent with Celestial Colonnade and Shark Typhoon tokens, and secure victory through card advantage and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells with cascade mechanics to overwhelm the opponent with threats and card advantage. By combining aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Brazen Borrower with cascade cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to create a fast-paced and explosive gameplay. The deck also includes versatile spells like Fury, Fire / Ice, and Prismari Command for added flexibility. With a mix of interaction, tempo plays, and powerful threats, the Cascade Crash deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while presenting a consistent and aggressive strategy.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out Emrakul, the Aeons Torn or other big threats from the deck. It also utilizes Transmogrify and Nahiri, the Harbinger as alternative ways to cheat out creatures. The deck includes a variety of control elements such as Remand and Teferi, Time Raveler to protect the combo pieces. Prismari Command and Wrenn and Six provide additional utility and card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to be creative in its approach to assembling a powerful board state and winning the game quickly.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to equip Colossus Hammer onto a creature and deal a large amount of damage in a single swing. This is achieved by using cards like Puresteel Paladin to reduce the equip cost of the hammer, Stoneforge Mystic to search for the hammer, and Esper Sentinel to control the opponent's actions. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga to search for key artifacts and utility lands, providing additional resources and resiliency to disruption.

This deck focuses on utilizing Cascade mechanics to quickly put pressure on the opponent and overwhelm them with powerful spells. By playing cards with Cascade abilities like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to cheat out big threats like Crashing Footfalls and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of various dual lands and mana fixing spells ensures the deck can consistently cast its spells and control the board. With a mix of disruption and aggression, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can establish their own game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Cascade mechanic with cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to bring out Living End from the deck, which allows the player to return all creature cards from their graveyard to the battlefield. By cycling through cards like Architects of Will and Street Wraith, the player can set up their graveyard and then unleash a powerful board presence with Living End. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Grief and Force of Negation to control the game and protect the combo.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay and quickly overwhelming the opponent. The key concept revolves around using low-cost creatures like Eidolon of the Great Revel, Goblin Guide, and Monastery Swiftspear to deal direct damage. The deck also includes a variety of efficient spells like Bump in the Night, Lava Spike, and Lightning Bolt to further damage the opponent. Additionally, the deck utilizes some burn spells like Boros Charm and Searing Blaze to clear the path for the creatures. The mana base is designed to provide optimal colors and includes land cards like Arid Mesa, Blackcleave Cliffs, and Scalding Tarn.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Tarmogoyf, Ragavan, and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure on the opponent early on in the game. It also includes efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to deal with threats from the opponent. Additionally, it incorporates card advantage and selection tools like Wrenn and Six and Expressive Iteration to maintain momentum and find key cards. The mana base is optimized to support the aggressive game plan with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands. Additionally, Urza's Saga provides additional value and threats to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Brazen Borrower while using Cascade spells like Violent Outburst to cheat out powerful cards like Crashing Footfalls. By cascading into multiple spells for free, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a flurry of threats. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive spells like Force of Negation and Prismari Command to protect its board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck is designed to apply constant pressure and force the opponent on the back foot from the very beginning.

This deck focuses on assembling a quick and powerful combo using equipment like Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin to deal massive damage in a short amount of time. By tutoring for key pieces with Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga, along with protection from cards like Shadowspear and Sigarda's Aid, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a flurry of fast, efficient attacks. Utilizing Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds an extra layer of resilience and consistency to the strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively play creatures and spells with Cascade to overwhelm the opponent with card advantage and powerful plays. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Crashing Footfalls, the deck can quickly flood the board with threats while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Negation and Dead / Gone. The aim is to apply pressure early and consistently while leveraging the Cascade mechanic to maintain a steady stream of threats and answers.

The deck focuses on utilizing the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate large amounts of mana quickly and cast powerful control spells and threats. Karn, the Great Creator can shut down opponent's artifacts, while Ugin, the Spirit Dragon provides board control. Emrakul, the Promised End is a game-ending threat, and Urza, Lord High Artificer creates more mana and card advantage. The deck includes counterspells like Condescend and Remand, while also having removal options like Repeal and Spatial Contortion. The goal is to establish control and overwhelm opponents with powerful spells.

The deck revolves around using equipment like Colossus Hammer and Cranial Plating to quickly power up creatures like Ornithopter and Memnite. Esper Sentinel helps control the opponent's hand, while Puresteel Paladin helps draw cards and equip for free. Stoneforge Mystic helps tutor for the needed equipment, while Lurrus of the Dream-Den can be a valuable companion for recursion. The deck aims to assemble the combo quickly and overwhelm the opponent with high-powered creatures equipped with powerful equipment. The mana base is focused on maximizing efficiency and consistency in setting up the combo.

The main concept of the deck is to utilize aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent along with cheap removal spells such as Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to control the board and apply pressure to the opponent. The deck also has card draw and selection tools like Mishra's Bauble, Serum Visions, and Expressive Iteration to maintain card advantage and consistency. The inclusion of disruptive spells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce helps protect the aggressive game plan, while cards like Blood Moon can disrupt opponents' mana bases.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on utilizing efficient spells and creatures to quickly overwhelm opponents and control the board. By using a mix of burn spells, card draw, countermagic, and evasive threats like Ragavan and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to maintain pressure while disrupting the opponent's strategy. The deck's key strategy is to apply early pressure with cheap threats and keep the opponent on the back foot by controlling the game tempo and using versatile spells to adapt to different matchups.
